quality_flags.detail: [mainflow_trigger_continuity] The Trigger enumerates multiple bid-placement initiators: QuickBid, QuickBid Now, SmartBid, and Single Bid. Main Flow step 3 only continues the Single Bid path via the 'Your Single Bid' dropdown and 'Place Single Bid' button; the QuickBid, QuickBid Now, and SmartBid triggers are not represented in the Main Flow. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (Explicit evidence that QuickBid Now places the bid without a confirmation pop-up.))

[mainflow_trigger_continuity] The Trigger says the use case begins when the Customer clicks QuickBid, QuickBid Now, Place SmartBid, or Place Single Bid. Main Flow step 1 instead begins with a different navigation action (clicking the product module to open Product Details), and step 3 only continues the Place Single Bid path. This is a real gap/restart, not just a concise restatement of the Trigger.
